note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it (Exophase / PSNProfiles, 2026-11-18). Every guide is written for this entry in our own words from the official description; where a step is not pinned down in any published source, the guide says so plainly.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours — there is nothing else to do for it directly. Work through the roadmap in order: story first, then strangers and contacts, then activities and collectibles, then the long grinds. The last trophies standing are usually 100% Completion and the 250 stunts.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the game's opening mission. It is the first story mission, so this is the first trophy most players earn, and it cannot be missed — just play the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. Story progress only; nothing optional is needed for it.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the story. Story progress only; nothing optional is needed for it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 of the story. Story progress only; nothing optional is needed for it.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the story. Story progress only; nothing optional is needed for it.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. It pops at the end of the campaign; no side content is required for it.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as you play through the story — keep following the campaign.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. A campaign mission; it comes in story order.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. A campaign mission; it comes in story order.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. A campaign mission; it comes in story order.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown. A campaign mission; it comes in story order. The name suggests it takes place at Vice City International Airport — that is a reading of the mission title, not a confirmed detail.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A campaign mission; it comes in story order.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% Completion — every story mission, stranger strand, activity and collectible the game counts toward completion. This is the long one: the checklist in this guide tracks the trophy side, but 100% also needs whatever the in-game completion counter lists. Save it for last, after the story and all the count-based trophies.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses and the like, as the game counts them. Stunts add up across the whole map while you play; the count is cumulative, so there is no rush and nothing to miss. If you are short at the end, chain jumps and near misses in freeroam traffic.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. PSN tracks 9 activity types — play one of each: the activities the list names include shooting ranges, drone races, races, fishing, arcade games and bowling, with more to find in the world. One attempt each is enough; you do not need to win.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. PSN tracks 42 challenges. Each challenge has its own gold score — repeat a challenge until you hit it; scores are per challenge, so you can clear them in any order.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. PSN tracks 14 locations. Win one race at each of the 14 — a win at a location you have already won does not help; you need all 14.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Twenty distinct race events, not twenty wins — winning the same race twice counts once. Work through the race list across Leonida.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him — the exact spot and rules are not pinned down in any published source yet, so treat this as a stranger-style encounter to find while exploring.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — play one through to its end. Any arcade game counts; pick the shortest one you find.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is one of the stranger contacts — play through his mission strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton is one of the stranger contacts — play through his mission strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy is one of the stranger contacts — play through his mission strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Eight full stranger strands — the named contacts (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) account for six, so you need at least two more strangers besides them. Meet strangers while exploring and finish each strand you start.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy is one of the stranger contacts — play through his mission strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone is one of the stranger contacts — play through his mission strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. PSN tracks 18 meditation spots. Visit all 18 and meditate at each — the spots are spread across the state, and no published map pins them all down yet.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret is a stranger contact with a hunting strand — follow his missions until the unique-animal hunt, then take the animal down. The species and location are not pinned down in any published source yet.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find and collect the cards for three full sets — cards are scattered across Leonida, and no published list pins every card's spot yet.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the game's photo-style activity — its exact form is not pinned down in any published source yet — and you need to do it at 100 different spots. The count is cumulative across the map.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. The game tracks challenges across its activities — finish any 50. They add up as you play the activities for the other trophies, so this usually pops on the way.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableNote: Needs your partner beside you — partner availability follows the story.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. You need your partner beside you and a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears. Partner availability follows the story, so try it while your partner is with you rather than leaving it to the end — the description ties it to your partner, which is why this guide flags it as possibly missable.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableNote: Needs your partner beside you — partner availability follows the story.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With your partner beside you, rob three shops in a row while keeping the heat on — do not let the wanted level drop between robberies. Like Hot Together it needs your partner, so do it while the story keeps you together.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter 100 different vehicles — the count is by model, so a second copy of a car you already found adds nothing. Variety beats volume: try everything you see.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the game's slow-time aiming mode. Wait for a group of at least five enemies, trigger it, and drop all five before it ends — a crowded firefight is the place to try.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: May be a one-off airport moment; keep a save before airport missions.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave Vice City International Airport in a way the airport did not schedule. The description is a riddle and no published source pins the method down; it may be tied to a mission moment at the airport. If it is a one-off moment, it could be missed — keep a save before airport missions. This guide flags it as possibly missable for that reason.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The description is a joke with no method in it, and no published source pins the trigger down — Rhinos are the game's tanks, so the trophy is most likely tied to stealing, driving or surviving one. Treat the method as unconfirmed until community guides pin it down.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Get in and out of a jewelry store robbery without raising the alarm — stealth only. If you are spotted, the attempt fails; retry from a save.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Hit five bank vaults and get away clean each time. Vaults are repeatable targets, so this is a count to work through, not a one-off.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take its cargo and lose the heat. Trucks spawn in traffic — a crime of opportunity, not a mission.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. PSN tracks 52 areas — visit every one. The count is by area discovered, so drive the map's edges and fill in whatever the in-game map still shows as unexplored.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. PSN tracks 9 gangs — hit one illegal operation for each of the nine. You need all nine gangs, not nine operations from one gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, find a spot with a view, and have a cocktail there. The description names the place; the exact bar or prompt is not pinned down in any published source yet.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a vehicle showroom's front — in through the showroom, out through the glass, the classic GTA way. Any showroom should do.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — the description names the alley, so go there rather than any other lanes.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: May be a story moment; the trigger is not pinned down.
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is cryptic and no published source pins the trigger down — it reads like a story moment with your partner that draws a crowd. It may be tied to a specific mission, so this guide flags it as possibly missable; keep saves as the story unfolds.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: Choices can branch and lock paths out; keep saves before big decisions.
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count to 500 — choices you make across the game. Some choices branch the story and may lock other choices out, which is why this guide flags it as the list's one clearly missable trophy: keep a manual save before every big decision so you can go back if a choice closes a path.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: May need a fail-then-retry moment; succeeding first try could skip it.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description suggests succeeding on a second attempt after failing once. If the trigger is a specific fail-then-retry moment, succeeding first time could skip it — this guide flags it as possibly missable, but the exact trigger is not pinned down in any published source yet.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: May be a one-off scripted event; the trigger is not pinned down.
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The description is a joke with no method in it — it most likely pops at a scripted strange event somewhere in the world. If that event is a one-off, it could be missed, so this guide flags it as possibly missable; the trigger is not pinned down in any published source yet.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a bat or your fists instead of a gun. Any target on foot should do.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — launder $250,000 of them through your contacts. It is a long count: keep robbing and laundering through the endgame.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in total at shops — clothes, weapons, food, anything with a price tag. The count is cumulative, so it pops naturally if you shop as you play.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. PSN tracks 8 garage properties — buy all eight. They cost money, so save this for after the money-making trophies or buy them as you can afford them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the Scooter Bros app to register ten vehicles you find. Any ten vehicles count — register as you discover them.
